rule: Baseline = LightGBM with the 20 v3 features (the two attitude-aware features excluded), fitted on sim_v4_val train, calibrated on its calibration split, measured on its validation split and on sim_v4_weakval (scored with the same fitted model and threshold). A feature set or added feature replaces the baseline only if ALL hold: (1) detection of consistent_takeover on sim_v4_val validation rises by at least 0.03; (2) detection of weak consistent_takeover on sim_v4_weakval rises by at least 0.03; (3) detection of weak-power sessions overall on sim_v4_weakval does not fall; (4) false alarms per hour on sim_v4_fahold do not exceed 1.0. If several qualify, take the one with the larger mean of gains (1) and (2).

candidate_sets.S_att: S_all without imu_resid_mps2 and imu_resid_long_mps2 (level-body IMU features)
candidate_sets.S_att_ekf: S_att plus ekf_innov_m and ekf_innov_vel_mps (M5, built in ten_layer_detector/ekf.py)

ablation: Each of code_carrier_m (F1), allan_dev_nsps (F6), const_diff_m (F7), dead_reckoning_m, baro_resid_m, imu_resid_long_mps2 (F4/F5) is dropped one at a time from the chosen set and the change reported. Dropping is reported only; features are not removed on this basis.

not_built.F2: pseudorange-ephemeris consistency: the simulator has no per-satellite positions or ephemeris, so there is nothing to test it against
not_built.F3: AGC: hardware-only (u-blox MON-HW); a simulator model written by the same author as the detector would be circular, so it is left for bench data

caveat: The validation sets hold 60 consistent-takeover and 28 weak consistent-takeover sessions per attack kind, so a 0.03 margin is inside sampling noise (about 0.04-0.09). The rule is applied as written anyway and the noise is stated in the report.
